## Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened (include error messages or stack traces if available).

## Screenshots / Evidence
If applicable, add screenshots or videos to help explain the problem.

## Environment Details
- **Role:** (e.g., Owner, Admin, Teacher, Parent, Student)
- **Language:** (English / বাংলা)
- **Browser:** (e.g., Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari)
- **Device:** (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile)
- **OS:** (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS)

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. tenant/school name, student ID, invoice ID).
